Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment specifically compares the hACE2 interactome in the presence versus the absence of the SARS-CoV-2 Receptor Binding Domain (RBD). While the study also performs genetic knockdown of SLC1A5 and pharmacological treatment with V-9302, these were validated via ELISA, FACS, and viral entry assays, not the mass spectrometry proteomics described in the PRIDE dataset (PXD038005). The MS analysis is a comparative Co-IP study. Mapping is set to the parent ligand_stimulation as the RBD acts as the receptor ligand.
